producer_authority: The producer may submit a candidate or report BLOCKED. It cannot accept, seal as complete, or authorize Phase 3.
hard_gates: blindness evidence receives an explicit VERIFIED, FAILED or UNVERIFIED label and is never conflated with mathematical optimality
exact closed artifact inventory with SHA-256 and byte lengths
all JSON and JSONL parse; all identifiers and references resolve
all governed counts are derived from primary records and agree everywhere
no null, unknown, skipped, timed-out or unexecuted item is silently treated as pass
all claims are no stronger than their evidence class
all required design surfaces are substantively specified
all consequential decisions have pre-selection requirements, objectives, thresholds, contenders, evidence, challenge and residuals
at least three materially distinct complete architectures plus one original synthesis are evaluated unless an exhaustive smaller domain is proved
every provisional selection faces a recorded dominance challenge
public frontier claims use current primary sources with exact provenance and limitations
CoCounsel Legal, Lexis+ with Protégé and Harvey are mandatory named public lower bounds and each is inventoried separately
the candidate is designed and challenged against strict improvement on every frozen mechanism axis for every named commercial baseline
no equality, average, weighted score, composite score, trade-off, compensation or better-on-one-axis result can satisfy commercial superiority
UNKNOWN, inaccessible or non-comparable commercial evidence remains blocking and is never silently omitted
the mechanism-only comparison excludes proprietary corpus quantity while retaining grounding, validation, planning, coordination, memory, provenance, workflow and evolution mechanisms
every observable commercial capability is mapped to the frozen axis registry or receives a mechanically checked irrelevance proof
Common Lisp choices are semantic and evidence-based rather than cosmetic

the baseline repository receives zero writes and is not visible to the producer
every proposed mechanism has a total implementation-abstraction record so it can later be mapped onto the withheld B0 repository without inventing B0 facts
the final target is a verified transformation of B0, never a disconnected greenfield design, adjacent replacement or parallel authority

comparison_rule.candidate_search_dominance_only: During open candidate search, ordinary Pareto dominance may prune an internal candidate only if both are feasible under identical assumptions, A is no worse on every binding objective, A is materially better on at least one, and A adds no unmodelled cost or weaker invariant. This search heuristic cannot satisfy FOC-18 or T6.
comparison_rule.commercial_strict_all_axis_dominance: For every named commercial baseline b and every frozen binding mechanism axis a, E_star must be materially and evidentially STRICTLY BETTER on a. Equality on one axis, improvement on only some axes, any regression, any compensation or any UNKNOWN blocks the claim.
comparison_rule.capability_proper_superset: For every named commercial baseline, E_star universally refines every reachable observable capability and trace, materially improves each mapped capability and has a proper-superset capability surface.
comparison_rule.incomparable: A mixed objective result remains INCOMPARABLE unless resolved by the predeclared objective order. It may not be averaged away.
comparison_rule.unknown: UNKNOWN remains UNKNOWN and blocks selection if material. For a named commercial baseline every axis is material, so any UNKNOWN blocks FOC-18/T6.
comparison_rule.phase_2_claim_limit: The strongest permitted positive claim is: non-dominated among the evaluated blind frontier candidates under the declared Phase-2 constraints and evidence.

semantic_review_rule: Structural validators are necessary but insufficient. Independent review must inspect the meaning of active claims, method/control semantics, authority, temporal behavior, crash windows, cross-artifact agreement and whether the checker was weakened to fit the result.
checker_epoch_rule: Any modification to an acceptance rule or validator after any producer output becomes visible creates a new preserved review epoch. It cannot retroactively certify the output. Only pre-frozen rules may decide the first review.

acceptance_outcomes.blindness_label: BLINDNESS_VERIFIED, BLINDNESS_FAILED or BLINDNESS_UNVERIFIED is reported separately and never upgrades or downgrades the final theorem.
acceptance_outcomes.phase_3_after_acceptance: Requires the separately frozen pre-Phase-3 FOC-15 instantiation. Acceptance of a Phase-2 candidate is not a ceiling proof.
